tab.label: Power
tab.note: Standalone tab: not part of the All-buckets book, By Style, Cross-Pair or Correlations. ICE monthly real-time power futures (USD/MWh), the five series whose Calendar-2025 time to trade 1 sigma risk is under 5 days (MISO OffPeak, 9.9 days, is excluded). The data start in 2015, so Full is 2017-2026 (every sleeve live; Value needs two years of F3) and P1 is not available.
